decisions.reason: Rye country bread builds directly on the firm's core rye bread knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the product.
The gold medal from the German Bread Institute signals strong quality and the product leverages existing stollen production capabilities.
Rye mixed bread with seeds is a variant of the firm's established rye bread line, so related knowledge supports learning and improvement.
Dark barley malt rye bread uses familiar rye and malt ingredients, giving the firm sufficient absorptive capacity to refine it.
Marzipan stollen is a seasonal extension of the firm's existing stollen expertise, though it lacks the external validation of the raisin stollen.
Ancient grain bread relies on less familiar grains like emmer and einkorn, weakening the firm's absorptive capacity to assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
